name: Pappasito's Cantina Receipt
description: This receipt is issued by Pappasito's Cantina and documents a dine-in restaurant transaction at a location in Houston, Texas. The header contains the Pappasito's Cantina branding, restaurant location and contact information, table details, and server information. The visible order includes a Single Cantina Fajita Beef item and a Large Margarita. The financial section records a subtotal of $32.90, tax of $2.71, and a final total of $35.61. The receipt states that the tip is not included and provides suggested gratuity amounts of 15% ($5.34), 18% ($6.41), and 20% ($7.12). The lower portion promotes online ordering, provides fields for an e-gift card number and PIN, and invites customers to provide feedback about their dining experience.
